title: The Casterwill Client/Quotes
summary:
"We've got a mystery to solve."
- Dante Vale

"Dante Vale is mine."
- DeFoe to Grier

"There's a nice house you boys are checking out. Doubling in real estate? Here I thought you were book collectors. If you want it, then come and get it, but I warn you - collecting suits is my hobby!"
- Dante Vale, to DeFoe and his Suits

"I thought you said your house was indestructable!" (Lok Lambert)

"Maybe, but my neighbours aren't." (Dante Vale)

"Nice work, with moves like those you'll be an elite Seeker someday."
- Dante Vale, to Sophie Casterwill

"Dante's the Foundation's number one Seeker. He's famous." (Sophie Casterwill)

"Hey, you're a celebrity!" (Lok Lambert)

"Very funny." (Dante Vale)

"I'm a professional treasure hunter and private eye. I don't come cheap. You can't afford me."
- Dante Vale, to Lok Lambert

"If you wanna dance, I'll show you some steps."
- Dante Vale, to Santiago

"You've been well trained, but you don't have the experience to take me on. This duel is over."
- Dante Vale, to Santiago (after landing on the edge of an overhang)
